messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P2 spike - elevated 5xx from gateway /api/v1/generate (us-east-1). Error rate 12% 5xx over last 5m. Pager: emily oncall.
emily: seeing it. hitting dashboard now. linking request rates and 5xx by route.
raj: joining — did we get the correlation IDs from the gateway logs?
emily: yes, grab a couple: corr=abc123def, corr=abc123fgh, corr=xyz987654. sample entry from gateway (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T14:12:01Z gateway[gw-7] INFO req=corr=abc123def method=POST path=/api/v1/generate status=502 upstream=model-host-2 error="upstream response: 502 Bad Gateway" latency_ms=124
```

maria: 502s clustered around model-host-2 and model-host-4. percentiles: p50 90ms, p95 430ms, p99 1.2s. Latency spikes then 502.
emily: previous deploy? no, no deploys in the last hour per deploy-bot.
simon: i was on the tail of the last shift — handoff notes: we saw intermittent kv-cache timeouts yesterday but resolved. this looks like a different pattern (upstream HTTP 502s). handing to raj for troubleshooting. @raj — take it.
raj: ack taking lead. first mitigation idea: disable gateway retries to avoid traffic amplification and route failing ID to fallback model variant while we deanonymize root cause. can we TTL to fallback for affected requests?
emily: can do quick route change, adding a condition for model-host-2/4 5xx spike to use model-v1-stable. command:
```
redwoodctl route update --selector region=us-east-1 --fallback-model model-v1-stable --condition "error_rate(5m, status>=500) > 0.05"
```

maria: before we flip, we should confirm which customers are impacted. support-ingest-bot, any open tickets referencing corr ids?
support-ingest-bot: found 3 active tickets in last 10m referencing corr=abc123* (cust: AcmeCorp, internal id TKT-4423). Impact: generation requests failing, users seeing 502.
emily: rolling the route change now (non-blocking canary to 10% traffic).
incident-bot: deploy started by emily at 14:17:02Z — rolling 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 5m window (canary policy).
raj: monitoring. pulling traces for corr=abc123def: trace shows gateway -> router -> model-host-2 receive request -> forward to model worker -> worker times out waiting for kv-cache response -> worker returns 502. trace link: https://traces.redwood.dev/trace/abc123def
emaria: (typo: maria) re: kv-cache — are we seeing elevated RTT or misses to the memcached cluster?
emily: memcache cluster looks healthy on host metrics, but we do see elevated connection resets to memcached from model-host-2. snippet from model-host-2 system logs: 
```
Mar 15 14:11:59 model-host-2 kernel: [net] tcp_reset: connection reset by peer to 10.12.8.3:11211
Mar 15 14:12:00 model-worker[pid=421] ERROR kvcache: failed get key=prompt:abc err="connection reset"
```

raj: hypothesis H1: transient memcached connection resets on model-host-2 causing worker-level failures -> 502. H2: model-worker thread starvation at scale causing timeouts -> 502. H3: client-side retry loops amplifying failures under load. tracking in-thread.
emily: mitigation status: canary to 30% at 14:19, 100% at 14:22. error rate drop to 2.5% at 14:25.
maria: good. we should still capture full request logs for postmortem. please run:
```
kubectl logs -l app=model-worker -n prod --since=30m | rg "corr=(abc123|xyz987)" > /tmp/incident-logs.txt
```

raj: grabbed logs and uploaded to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incident/1769012345/logs.tar.gz (contains gateway logs, model-worker logs, memcache tcpdumps).
emily: customer comms: supported contacted AcmeCorp with note: we see 5xx spike affecting generation calls; mitigation applied; monitoring continues.
simon: are there any ongoing fallbacks or degraded features? we toggled fallback-model which could change latency/quality. ops note for product: quality regression possible for some endpoints.
maria: tracking hypotheses with quick checks: H1 (memcached resets) evidence: connection resets in kernel logs, concentrated on host-2/4. H2 (worker starvation) evidence: no OOMs, CPU not saturated, but goroutine/thread dumps show long GC pauses on host-4. H3 (retry amplification) evidence: gateway logs show retries x3 for same corr ids increasing inflight to backend. preliminary rank: H1 > H3 > H2.
raj: next steps: 1) schedule deeper network debug on model-host-2/4 (tcpdump, connect-retries to memcache) 2) add short-term circuit-breaker in gateway for repeated 502s 3) arrange postmortem and customer impact summary. I can take network debug now — will also request host replacement for model-host-2 if connection resets persist.
emily: adding action items to incident board. tagging SRE-runbook: /runbooks/5xx-gateway.md.
incident-bot: NOTE: this thread will be archived after incident CLOSED.
raj: closing note: errors normalized by 14:26 after route fallback and disabling retries. filing RCA docs: will draft timeline and attach logs (s3://redwood-incident/1769012345/rca). assign owners: raj (investigation), emily (mitigation), maria (customer comms).
emily: thanks team. I'll keep monitoring for 1h then handback to next oncall. :thumbsup:
support-ingest-bot: AcmeCorp updated: TKT-4423 -> customer notified of mitigation at 14:28 UTC.
raj: final entries for timeline (rough):
- 14:11:55Z: first 502s detected by alerting (error rate > 10%)
- 14:12:01Z: pager alert fired, emily paged
- 14:14:30Z: raj joins, hypothesis start
- 14:17:02Z: route fallback canary started
- 14:22:00Z: fallback rolled to 100%
- 14:25:30Z: error rate dropped to baseline ~0.8%
- 14:28:00Z: customer notified (AcmeCorp)
- 14:30:00Z: post-incident tasks created and owners assigned

emily: logging handoff: i'll leave thread open for another 30m for any late signals, then mark resolved.
